text: Say - O Messenger - to these polytheists: Indeed, my Lord has guided me to the straight path that leads to His Paradise, and it is the religion of Islam, which upholds the affairs of this world and the Hereafter, and it is the religion of monotheism, the religion of Ibrahim, peace be upon him, and Ibrahim, peace be upon him, was not among those who associate partners with Allah besides Him.
